sections.title: Intercultural Communication
sections.description: Language is a complex and multifaceted phenomenon, simultaneously communicative,creative, and cultural. An intercultural perspective is vital to learning a new language and engaging meaningfully with speakers of other languages and cultures. Focusing on the key ideas of intercultural practices, reflections, and strategies, this course offers students a foundation for understanding language, culture, and communication as well as the intricate relationship between them.
